entries.EN:
This type of protective outfit has been developed especially for military stalkers. Includes a PSZ-12p heavy army flak jacket, integrated compensating suit and Sphere-12M helmet. Provides excellent bullet and splinter protection without reducing mobility and features a balanced anti-anomalous system and psionic shield.

entries.EN:
The Special Protective Suit "Vityaz" was developed in the Uralsky Research Institute in which the brand new "Liquid Armor" technology was used. The essence of the technology is the soaking of aramid fiber in a polymer gel containing super-hard metallic nano-particles that locally polymerize into an extremely hard substance under the influence of an abrupt hit. Phase transfer takes less than a millisecond, thus creating effective protection against penetration from high velocity objects, such as bullets and shrapnel. Features good mobility, low weight and high levels of protection. However, the material's molecular structure is extremely susceptible to intense radioactivity, active chemical agents and high temperatures which may damage and negatively impact the defensive characteristics. Comes with the latest generation of night-vision and an upgraded helmet featuring a psi-emissions suppressor.
 

		%c[0,255,255,255]FACTION ALIGNMENT: %c[0,170,170,170]Army

entries.JA_new:
「液体装甲」技術を採用した特殊防護服「ヴィチャズ」。ウラルスキー研究所で開発された。アラミド繊維を金属ナノ粒子入りのポリマーゲルに浸すと、強い衝撃を受けた部分だけが瞬時に硬化する。相変化にかかる時間は1ミリ秒未満で、高速の銃弾や破片の貫通を防ぐ。機動性と防護力に優れ、軽量でもある。ただし、素材の分子構造は強い放射線、反応性の高い化学物質、高温に極めて弱く、性能が損なわれるおそれがある。最新型の暗視装置と、サイ放射抑制装置を備えた改良型ヘルメットが付属する。
 

		%c[0,255,255,255]勢力： %c[0,170,170,170]ミリタリー

entries.EN:
Producer unknown. Protective properties are slightly worse then those of the PSZ-9a military bulletproof vest. Its structure is similar to the suit popular with neutral stalkers which combines a bulletproof vest and a radiation protection suit. Provides good protection from gunfire though its anomaly protection is low due to the absence of an air filtering system. A strange construction is integrated into the helmet and back of the suit.
